title: Ramadan Planner & Reflection Journal
subtitle: A 30-Day Worship Companion
description: Make the most of every day of Ramadan with this beautifully designed 30-day planner and reflection journal. Each day includes dedicated spaces for tracking your prayers, Quran reading progress, daily goals, and personal reflections. Whether you are preparing for your first Ramadan or your thirtieth, this journal helps you stay intentional, organized, and spiritually grounded throughout the blessed month.

title: Islamic Months Workbook for Kids
subtitle: Learn, Trace, and Color the 12 Islamic Months
description: A fun, hands-on activity book designed to teach Muslim children ages 5–8 the names and significance of all 12 months of the Islamic (Hijri) calendar. Each month features tracing exercises for the Arabic and English names, coloring pages with beautiful illustrations, and simple facts about the month’s importance in Islam. Perfect for homeschool, weekend Islamic school, or learning at home with parents.

title: Noor & Nova Twins: The Secret Garden of Skytail Valley: A Story-Driven Coloring Adventure for Kids, Teens and Adults | 50 Magical Scenes with Stories
subtitle: Skytail Valley Series Book 1
description:
Open the gate. The adventure is waiting.

Somewhere beyond the ordinary world, hidden behind a gate of golden vines and giant sunflowers, lies Skytail Valley — a magical place where flowers grow taller than houses, dragonflies glow at dusk, parrots carry secrets on their wings, and every path leads somewhere wonderful.

This is where Noor and Nova are going. And now, so are you.

Noor & Nova Twins: The Secret Garden of Skytail Valley is a story-driven coloring book unlike any other. Every right-hand page holds a beautiful, detailed coloring scene. Every left-hand page holds the story behind it — a few warm sentences to read before you color, so that when you pick up your pencil, you are not just filling spaces. You are living inside a moment.
What's Inside

    50 full-page coloring illustrations featuring Noor and Nova
    50 story pages — one for every scene
    5 magical chapters: The Hidden Gate · The Flower Kingdom · The Animal Gardens · The Skytail Festival · The Secret Bloom
    Beloved animal companions: fluffy cats, colorful parrots, butterflies, dragonflies, deer and more
    A "This Book Belongs To" keepsake page
    A "Thank You for Visiting" fill-in memory page
    Meet the Characters page and heartfelt author's note
    Clean bold line art — beautiful with colored pencils, markers, gel pens or watercolors

For All Ages

Children will love following the story and falling in love with the characters. Teens and adults will find the detailed botanical scenes deeply relaxing. The perfect book to color together as a family — or to enjoy in a quiet moment of your own.
What Makes Noor & Nova Different

Most coloring books are collections of unconnected pages. Noor & Nova is a story you color your way through — building attachment to characters, following a real adventure, and finishing with the warm feeling of a book well loved.

Noor wears her hijab with ease and joy — simply part of who she is. Nova runs beside her, curious and creative. Together they are characters any child can see themselves in, whoever they are.

Book 1 of the Skytail Valley Series. Collect all 6 books and follow Noor and Nova across every corner of their magical world.

— From Noor Creative Atelier · Preserving Wonder. Cultivating Connection.
